snippet.title: Realindustry — The Dependency | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
One Hyperdrive Engine. An entire civilization behind it.

What does one Hyperdrive Engine require?

Trace its dependencies from antimatter, quantum processors, superconductors, and advanced alloys all the way back to ore, heat, pressure, and chemistry. Plan the project, resolve every production step, automate the system, and take a colony from hand tools to an interstellar industry.

Every component requires a process.
Every process requires a system.
Every system requires a Director.

But NEXUS is monitoring more than production.

Realindustry is a hyper-realistic industrial simulation featuring:
• 236 materials with formulas, properties, and historical context
• 354 science-based production processes
• 56 industrial facilities
• 146 interconnected research projects across 10 technology tiers

Realindustry is available now on Steam.

Get the full game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4384850/Realindustry/

Play the FREE Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4525260/Realindustry_Demo

Join the Sector 08 Discord:
https://discord.gg/QwnaZxSBc6

Official Website:
https://realindustrygame.com/

Follow us on X:
https://x.com/RealindustryDev

Gameplay footage was captured in version 1.0.0. The release build is version 1.1.0 and includes additional UI and quality-of-life improvements.
